reviews.comment: Great prof! Really caring and takes her time with explanations. It's dense subject with lots of information to cover, but she explains things well, and the slides are fairly easy to study from. Exams are purely based on the lecture slides with some of the homework questions repeated. Most negative reviews are due to the difficulty of the subject.

I'm gonna say she's a good prof, and her exams are mostly based on the lecture slides and the questions are not hard nor twisted. The reason I didn't do well wasn't her problem; but rather my brain suffered severe exhaustion and wasn't able to take any more info. Besides that, take her!

2 exams and 1 comprehensive final. About 5 short homework assignments, highest 2 scores count and a third can be for extra credit. Exams were straightforward and homework questions were always tested on. Attendance is not mandatory but will definitely make the exams easier, a couple questions would be things said in class not directly from notes.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Farhy is a solid choice for cell biology. We covered so much information but Dr. Farhy laid out the information very easy to follow for us. She provides great explanations for us rather than to read straight from the slides. Exams are based on lecture material and HW, and are very fair. Very generous grading scale.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Only 2 midterm exams + a cumulative final (little bit of homework for padding). Lecture topics weren't organized in a very logical manner, and some of the exam questions came from out of left field. This class made so much sense during lecture and I studied really hard, yet the exams were so tricky. She seems nice, though, despite her course.

Dr. Farhy is very well-versed in Cell Biology, I love the discussion questions and applications to Nuerology given during lecture. The book is not really required but it is a good supplementary aid. Exams are pretty fair if you study well. She is so well at working with students to reschedule anything if needed and truly cares about our learning!

Grades are solely based on 3 tests (the lowest one dropped) and a final with some bonus points. The exams aren't hard and their free response, but what makes it difficult is to get an A in the class. If you're premed, I'd maybe suggest a different teacher, but she is good nonetheless. You'll be able to survive.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Your only grade is based on your tests. No homeworks and few tests means it's hard to pass if you mess up on a test. She tells you to not read the textbook and only use her slides, which have very little information on them. She won't release the exams either so you don't know what you missed. Would not recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor. Class only graded by 3 tests and the final, but she dropped the lowest test grade. Posts her lecture slides and video recordings of class. Would definitely recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Tests make up your entire grade, they aren't really that hard, just study the slides and you will be prepared. Lectures are really helpful, but they aren't necessary she uploads all the slides, and even recordings of the lectures online. Would take this class again.
